route: FontFace::create(ScriptExecutionContext&, family, ArrayBuffer, Descriptors) builds the face from copied caller bytes without VM entry.
A binary-buffer face loads synchronously: FontFace.cpp:166-170 calls CSSFontFace::load() when the data does not require asynchronous loading and asserts a Success or Failure status.
CSSFontFace::addClient/removeClient and CSSFontFaceClient::fontStateChanged report the face's actual terminal state for any asynchronous case.
Document::fonts()->add/remove registers the face only after Success and removes it at release or document invalidation.
